pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: Lo! We have given thee Abundance
So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice
Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance)
Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice
For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope)
